signatures.Experiments.Pal24Continuation.run_append:
Experiments.Pal24Continuation.run_append : ∀ (p : Experiments.Pal24Continuation.TransitionProfile) (state : p.State)
  (first second : List p.Input),
  Experiments.Pal24Continuation.run p state (first ++ second) =
    Experiments.Pal24Continuation.run p (Experiments.Pal24Continuation.run p state first) second
signatures.Experiments.Pal24Continuation.one_suffix:
Experiments.Pal24Continuation.one_suffix_of_step_simulation : ∀ (p : Experiments.Pal24Continuation.TransitionProfile)
  (related : p.State → p.State → Prop),
  (∀ (left right : p.State), related left right → p.observe left = p.observe right) →
    (∀ (input : p.Input),
        p.admits input →
          ∀ (left right : p.State), related left right → related (p.step left input) (p.step right input)) →
      ∀ {left right : p.State},
        related left right →
          ∀ (suffix : List p.Input),
            Experiments.Pal24Continuation.admissibleSuffix p suffix →
              Experiments.Pal24Continuation.oneSuffixEquivalent p left right suffix
signatures.Experiments.Pal24Continuation.all_finite:
Experiments.Pal24Continuation.all_finite_suffixes_of_step_simulation : ∀
  (p : Experiments.Pal24Continuation.TransitionProfile) (related : p.State → p.State → Prop),
  (∀ (left right : p.State), related left right → p.observe left = p.observe right) →
    (∀ (input : p.Input),
        p.admits input →
          ∀ (left right : p.State), related left right → related (p.step left input) (p.step right input)) →
      ∀ {left right : p.State}, related left right → Experiments.Pal24Continuation.continuationEquivalent p left right
signatures.Experiments.Pal24Continuation.aperture_e:
Experiments.Pal24Continuation.aperture_expansion_distinguishes_future : Experiments.Pal24Continuation.narrowProfile.observe
      (0, Bool.true) =
    Experiments.Pal24Continuation.narrowProfile.observe (0, Bool.false) ∧
  (0, Bool.true) ≠ (0, Bool.false) ∧
    Experiments.Pal24Continuation.continuationEquivalent Experiments.Pal24Continuation.narrowProfile (0, Bool.true)
        (0, Bool.false) ∧
      Experiments.Pal24Continuation.oneSuffixEquivalent Experiments.Pal24Continuation.wideProfile (0, Bool.true)
          (0, Bool.false) [Bool.false] ∧
        ¬Experiments.Pal24Continuation.continuationEquivalent Experiments.Pal24Continuation.wideProfile (0, Bool.true)
            (0, Bool.false)
